wife-of-pharaoh.name: The wife of Pharaoh
wife-of-pharaoh.title: The wife of Pharaoh
wife-of-pharaoh.dict: She asks that the infant Moses be spared (28:9), and is an example of those who believe: "My Lord, build for me, with you, a house in Paradise, and save me from Pharaoh and his works" (66:11). The Quran does not name her; tradition calls her Asiya.
